summary: Soligenix filed an 8-K to disclose an at-the-market (ATM) offering increase of $2.5M under the Sales Agreement with Rodman Renshaw LLC, bringing total capacity to ~$8.9M. No special-situation event—merely a routine shelf takedown adjustment. The filing includes an opinion on legality of shares. Terms: price determined at market, no fixed price, premium, or expected close. No advisory board recommendation or special mechanics. What to watch: incremental dilution risk from ongoing ATM sales.
